name: Master Services Agreement (MSA)
objective: Parse overarching commercial frameworks, liability caps, and termination rules.

attributes.name: Service Provider
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the legal name of the service provider party.

attributes.name: Client / Customer
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the legal name of the client party.

attributes.name: Initial Term
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the initial term/duration of the agreement.

attributes.name: Scope of Services
attributes.extractionPrompt: Summarise the overarching scope of services covered.

attributes.name: Liability Cap
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the limitation of liability cap amount.

attributes.name: Termination Clause
attributes.extractionPrompt: Summarise the termination rights and notice periods.

attributes.name: Signatories
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract signatory names and titles for both parties.
